meta.name: pua-reap-orphans
meta.description: PUA reap-orphans alias for Codex. Codex subcommand mapping for Claude Code /pua:reap-orphans style usage; invoke with $pua-reap-orphans.

copy.tagline: 清理代码仓库中的孤立文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要清理项目中不再被引用的文件。
copy.tagline_en: Clean up orphaned files in your code repository

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描过时的 PUA 代理状态，删除确认的孤儿记录，并报告证据。
howto.when: 当你在 Claude Code 中输入 /pua:reap-orphans 或使用 $pua-reap-orphans 别名时触发。

say.text: 运行 pua-reap-orphans 清理孤儿记录。
say.note: Claude 会扫描并删除过时的 PUA 代理状态。

say.text: 检查并清理 PUA 孤儿状态。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude scans for stale PUA agent state, removes confirmed orphan records, and reports evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /pua:reap-orphans in Claude Code or use the $pua-reap-orphans alias.

say_en.text: Run pua-reap-orphans to clean up orphan records.
say_en.note: Claude will scan and remove stale PUA agent state.

say_en.text: Check and clean up PUA orphan state.
say_en.note: Claude will report the cleanup result.
